name: Felicity Holloway
source:
Felicity Holloway is a rival debutante. She is first seen in Book 1, Chapter 6. 

Felicity is a proud and competitive woman. Even though she is the daughter of a viscount, she doesn't set her marriage prospects higher than Ernest Sinclaire. She pays compliments to Duke Richards and scolds Viscount Westonly for stepping on her foot, but doesn't pursue them aggressively. 

As soon as Your Character meets Felicity upon entering Mr. Sinclaire's London townhouse, she looks down on Your Character's being Vincent Foredale's natural daughter. If the player chooses to wear any premium dresses during the season, she will be envious and either mutter a compliment or try to criticize it (the second usually embarrasses herself in front of Your Character's grandmother). If the player decides to purchase items to make Your Character an Accomplished Lady, Felicity will be envious every time Your Character shows her talents. If the player does not purchase all the items, she is given the accolades as the accomplished lady at Duke Richards's ball, besting Your Character with her skills.

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Felicity_Holloway]Wiki[/url]]
